note: Targets inside the Liwa (eastern crescent: Wadhil / Mawsil), southern Abu Dhabi box. Roads and built-up areas: OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via the Overpass API (database timestamp 2026-11-15T04:10:14Z, retrieved 2026-11-15T04:11:20Z); roads split into segments <= 500 m, geometry = centre line, footprint = centre line +- half_width_m. Farms/plantations: NASA HLS L30+S30 v2.0 median NDVI 2024-11-01 to 2025-12-01 (end exclusive) >= 0.181, 30 m, >= 0.5 ha. hit_year_min/max: years in which migrating dune sand (measured Landsat 8/9 2013-2025 motion, detected windows only) is projected to reach the footprint: min = fast case (speed + 1 sigma) over the shortest plausible gap, max = slow case (speed - 1 sigma) over the longest; null = not reached by 2100 along the measured heading (hit_year_max is also null when the slow case arrives after 2100: see hit_year_max_uncapped). Excludes blowing sand (see borders_free_sand), sand already on the target, motion below the detection limit and dune deformation. Computed by pipeline/03_threats_and_frames.ipynb.
